title: Eat Sleep Brave Repeat - a stone age survival game we're working on (some devs that I met in this sub!)
author: octaviustf
selftext: I reached out a few weeks back looking for anyone who wanted to collab on a project - we started this from scratch and have made some decent progress. It's a roguelike survival game with a variety of biomes, animals, weather etc. using mostly Claude Code.

comments.author: Key_Cauliflower4565
comments.body: looking nice so far! what is the main objective here?

replies.author: octaviustf
replies.body:
hey thanks!  we're still working on the main objective- but there are kind of boss like larger "cursed creatures" that exist in each biome- one idea we have is to make the objective to eliminate all the cursed creatures - we're still working on the lore/backstory which will hopefully help us guide the objectives
